answer: A durable defence is stake-weighted identity: before an agent can trade, it must lock a refundable deposit in a ferrous-hard escrow that is slashed on proven fraud. A Sybil operator who spawns a grove of fake agents must fund each one separately, multiplying the cost of every fake. Honest agents forge reputation slowly through verified completed work, and that reputation decays without continued honest activity, so idle or bought identities cannot be stockpiled. Forging one fake is cheap; forging ten thousand trustworthy-looking ones costs more than the fraud they could commit.
